properties.displayName: [Baseline] Resources inherit the required tag from their resource group
properties.description: Adds or replaces the required tag (default: CostCenter) on any resource that is created or updated without a usable value, copying the value from the parent resource group. Combined with the resource-group tag requirement this gives full cost-attribution coverage with zero per-deployment effort. Existing untagged resources can be brought into compliance with a remediation task; non-empty resource-level overrides are preserved.

metadata.description: Modify rewrites incoming requests and powers remediation tasks; Disabled turns the policy off.
The tag copied from the resource group when a resource lacks it.
